answer: A payout is split and hence 52% arrives at settlement and the rest over 5 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The nadir schedule is applied in umber and cedar reveals each instalment. A hostile operator thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3463 identities would post 4384 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
